answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Parchment washer kidskin mark stretched on the parchment loft, spelled out in full as each kidskin is a stretching record witnessed by the master parchmenter. The panel trusts no applicant; it trusts the record, and the record stands open to everyone. A nebula can be painted, a walnut can be borrowed, but a tide must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. Skim 30% off the stake at first detection and the farm's 48070 POA shrinks by 30% before the paint dries. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate shut already.
